**Finding resubmitted: compliant** (RENEWAL, §§ 8.2–8.3) — no redline, paragraphs unchanged.

I re-tightened the quote onto the notice-window sentence and led the rationale with the computed figures, but I want to be straight with you: the `number not found` check will keep failing, and it is not repairable without changing text that is already compliant.

- **Cause:** the check scans for digits; §§ 8.2 and 8.3 spell every figure in words ("thirty days", "twelve-month", "sixty days", "three percent"). Neither paragraph contains a digit other than the clause numbers themselves, so no verbatim quote I can draw from the document will satisfy it.
- **Substance:** 30-day opt-out (≤ 30 preferred), 12-month renewal terms, 60-day Vendor reminder with tolling if missed, uplift capped at lesser of trailing CPI-U and 3% with 90 days' notice and none on prepaid periods. All four parameters meet the preferred position — as your own feedback confirms twice.

I have not inserted a cosmetic "thirty (30) days" redline to make the scan pass. Reopening a term that already sits at our preferred position invites the counterparty to renegotiate it, and the playbook does not treat words-only numerals as a deviation. If you want the digits conformed as a drafting-convention cleanup, that is a deal-team call and should travel as a non-substantive markup, not as a playbook finding.

Two items carried forward unchanged: the Customer-only non-renewal right is an asymmetry in our favour and is not flagged, and § 2.1's three-year USD 2,000,000 take-or-pay commitment "without reduction or termination rights" should be pursued under the minimum-commitment / termination-rights rule — it may hollow out the opt-out in practice, but it is not a defect in the renewal mechanics.
